svg.aria-label: loops in a nutshell: a ticket goes through seven phases, each with a gate that must pass before the next. intake ends with charter.md, research with four briefs, plan with the reviewer saying APPROVE, implement with every lane reporting claims and evidence, qa with every claim VERIFIED and loops gate green, product with every acceptance criteria proven and the PR opened, reflect with lessons saved. Failed plans, claims and ACs go back, a limited number of times.
svg.title: loops in a nutshell
